title: Psionics
description: Thought, crystallised. A science that should not exist.

puzzle.goal: Ions of charge number z in a nerve membrane drift for two reasons: they diffuse down their concentration gradient, and the electric potential V pushes them. Write the ion flux j through the membrane in terms of both gradients (molar quantities).
puzzle.name: Nernst–Planck equation (resting potential)
puzzle.form: - D * ( d ( c , x ) + z * F / ( R * T ) * c * d ( V , x ) )
puzzle.expr: R * T / ( z * F ) * ln ( co / ci ) * 1000
puzzle.ask: Setting j = 0 and integrating across the membrane gives the equilibrium potential V = (RT/zF)·ln(c_out/c_in). Find it (in mV) for potassium in a neuron at body temperature.
puzzle.method: Diffusion gives −D dc/dx; the drift velocity in the field is the mobility times the force, and the mobility is D/(RT) per mole (zF per mole of charge).
